t: khatrat ayran v yadnamh ashy kaga atsvavjy
dvrh y mkhtsr tarykh frhng ayran
Sargozasht Va Aghayede Falsafiye Khaje Nasir
Ravabete Hekmate Eshragh Va Falsafeye Irane Bastan
hftad v sh mlt mhmd jvad mshkvr
Estelahate Falsafi Va Tafavote Anha Ba Yekdigar
Enteghale Olume Yunani Be Aalame Eslami
Maghame Falsafe Dar Doreye Tarikhe Iran
Kitabi Dede Qurqud Ve Islam Dini
Dil Bele Oxu Bele Yaz Ali
Az Hale Bad Be Hale Khoob
shrbt hay ayrany v nvshydny hay snty
rah jvan mandn ba ghza v dvahay gyahy
Tandorosti Va Shadabi Ba Barname Ghazaee
chalsh bray ghdrt v srvt dr jnvb ayran
Hasti Az Nazare Falsafe Va Erfan
tarykh adbyat ayran az bastan ta ghajaryh
